title: Contratação de Social Media com Habilidades de Design e Redação
description:
O objetivo é encontrar um profissional de social media que possua habilidades tanto em design quanto em redação. O trabalho envolve a criação de conteúdos visuais e textuais para redes sociais, exigindo criatividade, domínio de ferramentas de design gráfico e excelente comunicação escrita. O público-alvo são seguidores e potenciais clientes nas redes sociais. Espera-se que o profissional entregue posts atraentes, alinhados à estratégia da marca, e que compreenda tendências digitais para aumentar o engajamento.


Responsabilidades


Planejar e executar estratégias de conteúdo para redes sociais, alinhadas aos objetivos da marca e às tendências do mercado digital.


Criar posts, stories, vídeos curtos e anúncios, desenvolvendo tanto o conceito visual quanto o texto criativo de forma integrada.


Gerenciar o calendário editorial, garantindo consistência de comunicação e coerência entre campanhas, datas e temas relevantes.


Produzir artes e peças visuais utilizando ferramentas de design gráfico (como Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator ou similares), sempre seguindo o guia de identidade visual da marca.


Escrever legendas, roteiros e chamadas atrativas, com domínio da escrita criativa e foco em engajamento e conversão.


Monitorar métricas e interações, analisando resultados de campanhas e propondo melhorias contínuas com base em dados.


Interagir com a comunidade online, respondendo mensagens e comentários de forma empática, clara e dentro da voz da marca.


Colaborar com outras áreas (como marketing, performance, design e atendimento) para garantir integração e consistência nas entregas.


Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências de redes sociais, comportamento do público e novas ferramentas de criação e análise.


Qualificações


Experiência prévia em gestão de redes sociais e criação de conteúdo (portfólio será considerado um diferencial).


Domínio de ferramentas de design gráfico, como Photoshop ou Figma.


Excelente escrita e criatividade, com capacidade de adaptar o tom de voz a diferentes plataformas e públicos.


Noções de fotografia, vídeo e edição básica, para criação de conteúdos ágeis e originais.


Conhecimento das principais métricas de engajamento, alcance e conversão em plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn e Facebook.


Capacidade de organização e autogestão, com atenção a prazos e detalhes.


Perfil colaborativo, proatividade e interesse genuíno em criar conteúdo relevante e de impacto.

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Job Title:

Staff Software Engineer


Job Type:

Contract


Contract Length:

6–12 months (with strong potential for extension)


Rate:

Competitive hourly rate (USD) — based on experience


Role Location:

Remote (LATAM) — must be able to work PST hours


The Company:

A fast-growing AI technology company building backend systems that enable clinical and operational tools used by healthcare organizations. The team combines engineering and research expertise to build safe, reliable AI services for use in regulated data environments. The company is focused on practical, production-grade systems rather than research prototypes.


Role and Responsibilities:

  • Design and build scalable backend infrastructure to support AI applications used in healthcare environments.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers and scientists to develop high-throughput data pipelines and microservices.
  • Develop APIs and distributed systems that enable secure data retrieval, processing, and model integration.
  • Ensure patient data protection through strong privacy and security measures across systems.
  • Monitor, optimize, and maintain backend performance to meet enterprise reliability standards.
  • Partner with product managers and healthcare teams to translate clinical needs into technical solutions.
  • Mentor junior engineers , fostering technical growth and best practices within the engineering team.


Job Requirements:

Must Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in backend engineering (Python, Go, or Java).
  • Proven experience building distributed systems (databases, pub/sub, Kafka, Redis).
  • Expertise in cloud platforms (GCP or Azure preferred; AWS acceptable).
  • Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD , and cloud networking.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture , data modeling , and security/privacy frameworks .
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work LATAM-based hours aligned with PST .

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain) or vector databases for AI/ML workloads.
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments (HIPAA familiarity is a plus).
  • Interest in mentorship and architectural decision-making at scale.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Senior UI Designer - Part time
description:
Client location: Remote (EST hours required)

Type: On-Demand / Part time Placement (Long-term, multi-year engagement possible)


Overview

We are seeking an experienced UI Designer to join our design team in an on-demand capacity. This position supports overflow project work, ad hoc design needs, and team coverage during PTO. While the work will vary depending on client and project demands, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to strategic, high-impact design initiatives.

This is not a freelance, flexible-hour role, candidates must be available full-time during EST working hours to collaborate with internal and client teams, attend meetings, and deliver design solutions as needed. Open to be worked remotely in any south American country


Key Responsibilities

  • Support active design projects as needed during staff PTO and overflow periods.
  • Mentor and guide other UI Designers.
  • Define and implement visual direction for project rollouts.
  • Develop and maintain design systems and style guides.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles with clients and stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the strategic vision of the user experience.
  • Lead design reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Participate in project planning and scoping activities.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and developer specifications.
  • Conduct user research and analyze user feedback.
  • Ensure designs are accessible and adhere to WCAG and usability standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on project goals and timelines.
  • Communicate design decisions effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Follow Curio’s Figma Etiquette for all design files.
  • Maintain design consistency across products and platforms.
  • Stay current with Apple HIG, Google Material, and Web Design Best Practices.


Typical Tasks

  • Design support for Proof of Concepts (POCs) and RFPs.
  • Contribution to case studies and internal initiatives.
  • Long-term design maintenance and system updates.


Required Skills

Primary Skills

  • Expertise in Figma (including advanced component systems).
  • Strong understanding of Apple HIG, Google Material Design, and web design best practices.
  • Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Skilled in design presentation and client communication.

Secondary Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Animation and motion design.
  • Video editing and print design.

title: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
XILO , a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a talented and visionary Product Designer with a strong command of user interface design to elevate the intuitive nature and value of our SaaS platform through innovative designs rooted in customer feedback.


About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedulethat are directly aligned with customer needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma that effectively communicate design concepts 2 sprints ahead of engineering timelines.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.


What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.


At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

  • Lead a regional team of 4 to 10 Workforce Administration professionals, providing coaching, managing performance, and fostering continuous professional development.

  • 7+ years of proven experience in HR operations, HR Shared Services, or Workforce Administration, with a strong focus on a multi-country or international environment.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management, including leading, coaching, and managing the performance of direct reports.

São José do Rio Preto/SP.

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions

  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

description:

Fornecer orientação especializada sobre melhores práticas para modelagem de conteúdo, desenvolvimento de componentes e gerenciamento de ativos digitais na plataforma brXM.

Diagnosticar e resolver questões técnicas complexas relacionadas às implementações de brXM.

Supervisionar a entrega técnica completa dos projetos brXM, incluindo desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento multifuncionais para garantir a execução fluida dos projetos.

Garantir que as entregas técnicas atendam a altos padrões de qualidade e sejam entregues no prazo.


Mentoria & Compartilhamento de Conhecimento:

Orientar desenvolvedores juniores sobre as melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades do Bloomreach.

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de metodologias internas, ferramentas e melhores práticas para implementações brXM.

Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tendências e atualizações no espaço de plataformas de experiência digital (DXP) e no roadmap de produtos Bloomreach.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Mais de 5 anos de experiência com plataformas CMS ou DXP de nível empresarial, sendo pelo menos 3 anos focados especificamente no Bloomreach Experience Manager (brXM).

Expertise profunda em desenvolvimento Java e no Spring Framework, incluindo Spring MVC, Spring Boot e Spring Security.

Experiência comprovada com os principais recursos do brXM, como o modelo Headless State (HST), Content as a Service (CaaS) e modelagem avançada de conteúdo.

Forte entendimento da arquitetura baseada em componentes do brXM e experiência no desenvolvimento de componentes personalizados, templates e plugins.

Conhecimento extensivo das APIs nativas do brXM para gerenciamento de conteúdo, usuários e personalização.

Especialização na integração do brXM com sistemas terceiros, como CRMs, PIMs, plataformas de e-commerce (ex: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Hybris) e ferramentas de automação de marketing.

Proficiência em tecnologias modernas de front-end (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+) e experiência com frameworks populares como React, Angular ou Vue.js para construção de aplicações desacopladas ou headless.

Experiência com ferramentas de build e gerenciamento de dependências (ex: Maven, Gradle) e sistemas de controle de versão (ex: Git).

Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas DevOps, incluindo pipelines CI/CD, containerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Experiência em tuning de performance e otimização de aplicações brXM, incluindo estratégias de cache e otimização de banco de dados.

Compreensão de tecnologias de busca e sua integração com brXM, especialmente Bloomreach Search ou Apache Solr/Elasticsearch.

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada, ou experiência prática equivalente.


Qualificações Preferenciais:

Certificação Bloomreach Developer ou Architect.

Experiência com outros componentes da suíte Bloomreach (ex: Bloomreach Search & Merchandising, Bloomreach Engagement).

Experiência em ambiente de desenvolvimento Agile/Scrum.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

  • Partner with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to define requirements, select algorithms, and deliver impactful ML solutions.
  • Architect, optimize, and maintain ML infrastructure — including data ingestion, model training, deployment, serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management — using AWS services.
  • Lead the data preparation and feature engineering process, ensuring data quality, integrity, and scalability across large datasets.
  • Implement and optimize ML models (supervised, unsupervised, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems) with a focus on performance, accuracy, and reliability.
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines and orchestration workflows to support ML systems at scale.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guiding best practices throughout the ML lifecycle.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of professional experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning models in production environments.

  • Expert proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation ) for deploying ML infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of data processing and analysis tools (Pandas, NumPy, SQL) and orchestration workflows.
  • Proven track record deploying ML systems into production and integrating them into real products or services at scale.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and MLOps best practices.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, or agentic AI systems.
  • Expertise in deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Amazon SageMaker for model lifecycle management.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or publications in the field.
  • Understanding of data engineering workflows, ETL pipelines, and real-time data processing

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

title: Product Owner
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Sobre a área:

A área de Produto Digital é responsável por evoluir os produtos da empresa, garantindo alta performance, experiência do usuário diferenciada e integração com os demais. Temos como objetivo aumentar a adoção, engajamento e satisfação dos usuários, assegurando entregas alinhadas às estratégias de negócio e à qualidade técnica esperada.


Principais atividades:

Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos.

Análise de mercado e Bench com identificação de tendências de aplicativos e canais digitais.

Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e critérios de aceitação claros.

Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras. Tomar decisões de Go/No Go da entrega na Review;

Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões

Conduzir refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas seguindo metodologias ágeis.

Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades junto aos usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.

Gerenciar os stakeholders e garantir a comunicação (estratégias e ações).



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Necessário graduação completa.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Necessário conhecimento em Scrum e frameworks ágeis.

Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou posição similar, com atuação em produtos digitais.

Vivência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis (iOS e Android).

Habilidade em análise de métricas de produto (Firebase, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar na gestão de aplicativos digitais , com foco especial no aplicativo de resultados de exames , garantindo priorização assertiva das demandas e interlocução com diferentes áreas e regionais. Procuramos alguém com experiência avançada em aplicativos digitais , que seja articulada, saiba se posicionar com clareza e tenha facilidade em conduzir conversas estratégicas com diferentes públicos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad , garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da área. Também terá atuação próxima do time digital localizado em São Paulo , influenciando e direcionando prioridades de forma indireta e estruturada.

Buscamos alguém com conhecimento aprofundado sobre as lojas da Apple e Google , incluindo políticas, publicações e boas práticas de atualização de aplicativos.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e com critérios de aceitação claros.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras.
  • Realizar análise de mercado e benchmarking para identificar tendências em aplicativos e canais digitais.
  • Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas).
  • Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades com usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders e garantir a comunicação clara sobre estratégias e ações.

Se você tem perfil estratégico, domínio de aplicativos digitais e gosta de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.



Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: 5x2

Horário de Trabalho: de segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Coordenação de Eficiência Energética
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Definir política, metas, baseline e governança de eficiência energética, alinhado à ISO 50001.
  • Gerir portfólio de projetos de eficiência, incluindo bombeamento, VFDs, reengenharia hidráulica e qualidade de energia.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar KPIs energéticos e financeiros (kWh/m³, R$/m³, demanda contratada vs. medida, FP, custo evitado).
  • Implantar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP), garantindo savings auditáveis com ajustes de baseline e sazonalidade.
  • Priorizar CAPEX/OPEX com business cases (TIR, VPL, payback) e conduzir TRs, RFPs e contratos de performance.
  • Integrar dados de medição e padronizar cadastros e repositórios energéticos.
  • Liderar equipe técnica e engajar áreas multifuncionais, reportando resultados a fóruns executivos e auditorias.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em eficiência energética ou gestão de energia.
  • Vivência prática em liderança de equipes e gestão de pessoas.
  • Domínio técnico em sistemas de bombeamento, motores, acionamentos (VFDs), fator de potência e qualidade de energia.
  • Conhecimento em tarifação, contratos de energia e medições com analisadores.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de Medição e Verificação (IPMVP).
  • Excel avançado.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações: CEM, CMVP, ISO 50001, PMP ou metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e/ou SQL.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

  • Conduzir análises retroativas e de performance dos modelos (backtesting, estabilidade de variáveis, KS, AUC, PSI, curing rate, hazard e survival curves) para identificar desvios e propor evoluções metodológicas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Crédito, Cobrança, Contabilidade, Financeiro e Risco, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em soluções analíticas robustas e sustentáveis.
  • Acompanhar práticas de mercado e evoluções regulatórias, propondo inovações que aumentem a eficiência do provisionamento e a precisão das estimativas de risco.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em modelagem de risco de crédito regulatória (PD, LGD, EAD e Estágios IFRS9).
  • Domínio técnico das normas IFRS9 e regulamentos BACEN (4966, 229, 2682).
  • Proficiência em Python (pandas, pyspark, scikit-learn) e SQL, com foco em manipulação e modelagem de grandes bases de dados.
  • Vivência com Databricks e Spark, preferencialmente em ambientes de produção (Delta Tables, workflows automatizados).
  • Sólida experiência em avaliação de performance de modelos (KS, AUC, PSI, estabilidade).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento, governança e documentação de modelos (MLflow, Git, Confluence).


Desejável

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, bancos digitais ou consultorias de risco regulatório.
  • Conhecimento prático de provisão contábil, roll rates, vintage analysis e estrutura de matrizes de transição.
  • Noções de LGD baseada em recuperação e fluxos de castigo (cash flow de perda).


O que você vai encontrar por aqui?

Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.

Se sim, peça o e-mail corporativo dessa pessoa e, ao se inscrever para uma vaga, utilize-o para solicitar uma recomendação. É uma excelente oportunidade para fortalecer sua rede de contatos e avançar no seu processo seletivo em nossa empresa!

A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.

Convidamos #Mulheres, #PessoasNegras, #PessoasComDeficiência, pessoas da comunidade #LGBTQIA+, #Gestantes e pessoas com #50anos+ a se candidatarem para esta vaga!

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • The Data Feeds team manages the data feeds business at YipitData. We partner with systematic and quantamental investment firms by providing access to alternative data for investment analytics and model development.
  • Become part of a growing team where your ideas and collaboration will have a direct impact on how we deliver value to top-tier investment firms.


About The Role:

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support , enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData’s data feeds effectively.


We expect East Coast work hours.


As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients’ investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).
  • Collaborate with Product to improve product features based on client feedback.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline or finance-related field.
  • Experience in financial markets (Nice to have) ; excellent client-facing communication skills.
  • Experience working with US clients is highly preferred
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), SQL, Databricks (preferred), Jupyter, and AWS (Knowledge focused on answering clients’ questions).


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Especialista em Eficiência Energética Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Levantar dados de campo junto às unidades de negócio (bombas, motores, pressões, vazões, faturas e medições elétricas) e construir baseline energético.
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos (ponto de operação vs. BEP, setpoints, perfil de carga, demanda, fator de potência e harmônicos).
  • Modelar soluções e elaborar business cases (VFDs, adequação de motobombas, correção de FP, rebatimento de pressão, geração distribuída fotovoltaica).
  • Elaborar termos de referência e memoriais técnicos, apoiando na equalização técnica de RFPs.
  • Acompanhar implantação e comissionamento das soluções, validando desempenho e resultados pós-projeto.
  • Executar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP A/B/C/D), manter repositório de evidências e emitir relatórios de economia de energia.
  • Construir dashboards e análises (Excel/Power BI) para acompanhamento de KPIs e rotinas de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em eficiência energética/gestão de energia.
  • Domínio de sistemas de bombeamento e acionamentos (VFD/soft-starter), leitura de diagramas elétricos e grandezas de qualidade de energia.
  • Vivência com medidores/analisadores, tarifação e análise de faturas.
  • Conhecimento em M&V (IPMVP) e estatística básica (normalização por clima/produção).
  • Proficiência em Excel.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens recorrentes às unidades de negócio.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações CMVP, CEM e/ou ISO 50001.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Experiência prática em campo com medições e comissionamento energético.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Masters / PHD In Science
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Science with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Engenheiro de software sênior

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir iniciativas de arquitetura e modernização de sistemas legados, adotando tecnologias modernas e metodologias ágeis para aumentar a eficiência e a manutenibilidade.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho das aplicações, aplicando métricas, logs e ferramentas de observabilidade para garantir estabilidade em ambientes críticos de operação.

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status; nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity; strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week
  • Consistent schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Fully remote: Work from anywhere
  • Direct collaboration with an entrepreneurial leader
  • Exposure to multiple industries: Construction, lead generation, nonprofit, real estate
  • Ground-floor opportunity: Help build foundational systems for scaling ventures
  • Learning environment: Strong focus on AI implementation and automation
Company Culture & Values


Culture in one line: We are problem solvers—systems over heroics—and the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.


Core Values:

  • Integrity
  • Growth Minded
  • In Service to Others
  • Provide Solutions
Onboarding & Support


There is currently no formal onboarding program—this will be part of the early partnership. You'll collaboratively identify the tools and support structures needed to achieve great outcomes. This is an opportunity to help shape the operational foundation from the ground up.


Application Process


Please send the following to (operations+ ) :

  • Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.pdf)
  • Cover Letter addressing:
  • How you meet the required skills and experience
  • Specific examples of systems or SOPs you've built
  • Your experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, automation tools)
  • A time you anticipated a leader's needs and proactively solved a problem
  • How you've closed loops and driven projects to completion
  • Why you're interested in supporting multiple ventures simultaneously
  • AI Competency Example: Share a specific example of how you've used AI tools to automate a workflow, solve a problem, or improve efficiency
  • Email Subject: Systems Over Heroics

Timeline: We aim to fill this position within 2–3 weeks.

Well-structured and thoughtful applications demonstrating critical thinking and systems-first approach will stand out. If you have questions about the role, feel free to include them in your message.

title: UX Designer – Food Delivery Operations
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a UX Designer, you will be focused on designing and evolving digital products that optimize kitchen operations, inventory management, and location handling for multiple stakeholders. You will work across mobile, large screens, and web platforms, contributing from ideation to post-release improvements, always keeping usability and efficiency at the center of your work.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deeply analyze business problems and user needs to identify pain points and propose user-centered solutions;

  • Present your work, articulate your design decisions, and provide clear documentation;
  • Manage your time effectively and work proactively to keep projects moving forward.


Essential Skills

  • Experience designing end-to-end digital products for web, mobile, and large-screen applications;
  • Strong experience in B2B UX for complex operational or internal tools;
  • Proficiency in Figma, FigJam, and collaborative design workflows;
  • Experience leveraging AI tools such as Figma Make, Perplexity, and Vercel to streamline and speed up design work;
  • Strong knowledge and practice in both UX and UI design;
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments or startups;
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work closely with cross-functional teams in Agile environments;
  • Knowledge of food industry operations, kitchens, and inventory management processes is a plus.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país.
